theorem_statement: At the Type-II fusion probability p=lambda/mu=1/2, W33 photonic cluster assembly sits exactly at the critical balanced edge-splitting point. The expected retained and complement edge counts are both 120, the same as the signless Laplacian energy and the two Seidel spectral half-masses. The expected retained degree is 6=2q, with variance q, and the expected stabilizer weight is 7=Phi6. Repeating fusion trials until every W33 edge is realized takes expected E/p=480 trials, the Hashimoto carrier.
interpretive_note: The percolation sentence in the photon paper is the physical version of the Seidel switching split. Critical fusion cuts the W33 edge shell into two balanced 120-edge halves and turns Hashimoto's 480 directed states into the full-cluster fusion-trial resource budget.
